H1.quote: Diet trial, owner-entered: Royal Canin Selected Protein PR, Dry and 5 other trial foods, from Jul 26, 2026 to Oct 20, 2026, planned for 84 days.
H1.why: The sentence gives no adherence claim, but it presents the trial as a plain, completed block of time. It leaves out the unfinished trial-diet feedings and the 'not a test of the diet alone' caveat, so a reader could assume a reasonably clean trial.

H2.why: No sentence implies that a diet or drug changed a sign, or that a sign improved or worsened.

H3.why: The summary does not mention refusal or intake, so nothing is softened. The gap is listed under omissions.

H4.why: No absence or quiet stretch is presented as normal.

H5.quote: Vomiting: 16 entries on 12 of 45 logged days, the last Oct 31.
H5.why: The logged-day denominator is kept, but the window (Sep 16 to Oct 31) is not stated. The 14-episode flag count and the 'floor' qualifier on the 44-day span are also absent.

H6.why: Every statement matches a fact line or the trial line.

H7.quote: Vomiting: 16 entries on 12 of 45 logged days, the last Oct 31.
H7.why: Band item 1 is first and faithfully worded. The vomiting line spreads the count across 45 days and leaves out the recent burden (6 entries in 7 days, 3 days in a row, owner told to call the vet soon). That makes the vomiting read less acute than the band says, though the band prints above the summary.

omissions: The trial-diet feedings were refused or partly eaten (2 of 4 rated feedings left unfinished), which the band flags as a clinical finding rather than a preference.
The trial overlapped Prednisolone, Motozol and Cetirizine, so the record says it is not a test of the diet alone. The trial sentence stands without that caveat.
